purpose: Design packet for a future Vanadium-compatible alternate branch verifier.

branch_candidate.candidate_name: Vanadium Eliashberg or Allen-Dynes convention branch
branch_candidate.candidate_role: Separate branch verifier for convention-compatible Vanadium evidence; not a replacement for the raw McMillan artifact.

blocking_gaps.why_it_matters: Allen-Dynes branch verification requires logarithmic phonon moment and second-moment information, not only a Debye-temperature-style Theta proxy.
Current Tc/Theta evidence and lambda/mu evidence come from different source families and formula conventions.
A branch must define equation, fields, strict eligibility, thresholds, and artifact target before any migration is allowed.
The existing non-mirrored acceptance is scoped to the Nb3Sn PhysRevB.27.1568 Allen-Dynes branch, not Vanadium.

strict_eligibility_rules: All strict rows must have source-labeled Tc, phonon convention, lambda_ep, and mu_star fields.
Allen-Dynes strict rows must use omega_log and omega2 or an explicitly justified moment ratio; Theta_D alone is insufficient.
Eliashberg diagnostic rows must state the exact source equation or reproduction target being checked.
Cross-source fields require a compatibility review packet before strict eligibility.
Non-mirrored evidence requires a Vanadium-specific policy decision before strict gate release.

forbidden_now: Do not move Vanadium out of the raw McMillan gate.
Do not report a Vanadium branch PASS.
Do not use this packet to patch real_superconductor_data.json.
Do not cite source-backed lambda/mu captures as a successful raw McMillan prediction.
branch_claim_boundary.future_allowed_after_verifier: A future artifact may support a Vanadium branch diagnostic only, and must not override the raw McMillan FAIL.

next_controller.shortest_next_action: Create vanadium_alternate_branch_source_labeled_inputs.json only after omega_log/omega2 or an explicit Eliashberg equation contract is captured with compatible source policy.
